| **Yoga & Wellness Retreat at The Retreat Center** | Catskill Mountains, NY | 7‑day program, vegetarian cuisine, full‑service spa, hiking & nature walks |
| **Yoga & Spa Retreat at The Retreat Center** | Adirondacks, NY | 5‑day retreat, vegetarian meals, spa treatments, yoga classes in scenic cabins |

If you’d like more detailed information (dates, pricing, booking links) or if you want me to look up a different type of accommodation, just let me know!
